cases.name: empty H2

cases.expected: Flyway executes V1..latest, Hibernate validate passes, second start performs no mutation
cases.authority: focused H2 integration test and Flyway history

cases.name: empty PostgreSQL
cases.fixture: empty PostgreSQL 16 Testcontainers schema
cases.expected: Flyway executes V1..latest and application core persistence smoke passes
cases.authority: PostgreSQL 16 integration test and Flyway history

cases.name: V3.9 H2 upgrade
cases.fixture: representative synthetic V3.9 H2 schema and data without Flyway history
cases.expected: exact signature is accepted, valid backup is created, controlled baseline V1 and migration complete with zero protected-record loss
cases.authority: legacy H2 upgrade integration test, count/hash comparison and backup manifest

cases.name: V3.9 PostgreSQL upgrade
cases.fixture: representative synthetic V3.9 PostgreSQL 16 schema and data without Flyway history
cases.expected: exact signature and explicit backup acknowledgement allow controlled baseline and migration with zero protected-record loss
cases.authority: PostgreSQL 16 legacy integration test and count/hash comparison

cases.name: unsupported schema
cases.fixture: partial or modified non-empty schema without Flyway history
cases.expected: startup blocks with UNSUPPORTED_LEGACY_SCHEMA and makes no schema/data mutation
cases.authority: negative integration test and before/after metadata hash

cases.name: failed or interrupted migration
cases.fixture: synthetic failing migration or invalid Flyway history
cases.expected: startup blocks with SCHEMA_MIGRATION_BLOCKED, original data and valid pre-upgrade backup remain recoverable

cases.name: rerun idempotency
cases.fixture: successfully migrated current database
cases.expected: restart and explicit revalidation add no duplicate facts/events/corrections/provider rows and apply no migration twice
cases.authority: two-restart integration test and stable counts/hashes

cases.name: new secure save
cases.fixture: new Provider with API key and available credential store
cases.expected: secret is write/read verified, DB stores only secretRef metadata and api_key remains null
cases.authority: credential service transaction test and direct DB assertion

cases.name: legacy plaintext migration
cases.fixture: V3.9 Provider row with plaintext api_key and no secretRef
cases.expected: store write and read-back precede one DB commit that sets secretRef and clears plaintext

cases.name: store write or verify failure
cases.fixture: credential store failure before DB update
cases.expected: legacy/new DB credential metadata is unchanged and plaintext legacy value is not cleared

cases.name: DB failure after secret write
cases.fixture: database transaction failure after successful store write
cases.expected: DB retains previous state; new orphan is removed or recorded for idempotent cleanup without secret content

cases.name: delete cleanup
cases.fixture: Provider with existing secretRef
cases.expected: successful delete removes both metadata and store entry; store failure preserves metadata and reports safe diagnostic

cases.name: masked read
cases.fixture: configured Provider API list/detail requests
cases.expected: responses expose only configured/masked status and never secret or full secretRef

cases.name: no secret log or artifact
cases.fixture: sentinel secret exercised through save, failure, migration, package and logs
cases.expected: sentinel is absent from API responses, logs, reports and release archive

cases.name: real provider through secure store
cases.fixture: Luna Responses, DeepSeek Chat and Qwen Messages profiles on one source head
cases.expected: each protocol completes bounded real smoke with credential resolved only by Model Gateway request path

cases.name: clean release start

cases.expected: manifest/preflight, backend migration, health and frontend start succeed

cases.name: no developer tools
cases.fixture: release PATH without Maven, npm, Git or system Java/Node
cases.expected: bundled Java/Node runtime starts package without source build
cases.authority: windows-latest environment and process command evidence

cases.name: read-only install
cases.fixture: release install directory treated as immutable
cases.expected: start/stop writes only external data root and install tree hash remains stable

cases.name: persistent external data
cases.fixture: created project/fact in release data root
cases.expected: data survives stop, package replacement and second start
cases.authority: Windows API smoke and DB count/hash

cases.name: restart stability
cases.fixture: at least two starts plus bounded 10-cycle start/stop loop when CI cost permits
cases.expected: health is stable, no repeated migration and backend/frontend ports are released after each stop

cases.name: port conflict
cases.fixture: foreign listeners on backend or frontend port
cases.expected: launcher reports PORT_CONFLICT and does not kill foreign process

cases.name: stale database/process lock
cases.fixture: stale ProjectFlow PID/lock and stale H2 lock without live owner
cases.expected: only identity-verified stale state is recovered; live/unknown owner blocks without data damage

cases.name: pre-upgrade backup
cases.fixture: H2 current database with pending migration
cases.expected: transaction-consistent backup, complete manifest and SHA-256 exist before migration starts
cases.authority: backup integration test and timestamped manifest

cases.name: backup restore
cases.fixture: valid H2 upgrade backup and modified current database
cases.expected: restore first protects current DB, verifies archive, restores in isolation and reproduces protected counts/hashes

cases.name: interrupted migration recovery
cases.fixture: migration failure after valid pre-upgrade backup
cases.expected: application remains blocked, backup remains valid and explicit restore returns the fixture to its pre-upgrade state

cases.name: incompatible binary rollback

cases.expected: INCOMPATIBLE_SCHEMA_VERSION blocks startup and no Hibernate update/down mutation occurs

cases.name: loopback default

cases.name: external/auth placeholder rejection

cases.name: sensitive-content boundary
